findings.evidence: JacobianChallenge/README.md lines 94–96 requires Weil divisors, Cartier divisors, and `(smooth curve) Weil ≃ Cartier`; lines 106–111 here relate integral fractional ideals only to effective Weil divisors on `HeightOneSpectrum R`, while `FractionalIdealDivisor.lean` lines 144–147 already provide the full affine fractional-ideal/Weil-divisor equivalence.
findings.fix: Add this positive affine refinement to the roadmap first, or replace it with work that introduces or connects to scheme-level Cartier divisors on smooth curves.
findings.issue: The new equivalence is an additional refinement of the already-existing fractional-ideal/Weil-divisor model, not a step toward the roadmap’s missing smooth-curve Weil–Cartier equivalence.

summary: The PR is coherent, but its effective affine Dedekind restriction does not advance the cited scheme-level Weil–Cartier target.
